description: Managed/authoritative DNS providers whose nameservers the ACTIVE axfr module never contacts (P281 FC3): a zone on a managed provider is almost never AXFR-misconfigured through the customer, and probing the provider's shared NS is noise against a third party. Matched by NS name suffix/substring (case-insensitive, trailing dot stripped). ASN matching is a best-effort refinement the module layers on top when an ASN lookup is available; see docs/backlog/p9-G13-2.md.
source: V3LUM batch p9-G13-2 (council list: Cloudflare, Route 53, Azure DNS, Google Cloud DNS, NS1, UltraDNS, Akamai, registro.br)
